# GOV.UK

> > The official website of the UK Government, providing public services, policy guidance, statistics, and official decisions.

GOV.UK serves as the central digital platform for UK government information, including guidance from HMRC, employment tribunal decisions, official statistics from departments like DBT and Defra, environmental permits, and policy reviews. All content is published under the Open Government Licence v3.0 and archived by The National Archives.

## Key Topics

- HMRC tax guidance
- Employment Tribunal decisions
- Official statistics
- Workforce management data
- Agricultural tenancies and farming policy
- Building safety and remediation
- Migration statistics
- Homelessness data
- Environmental permits
- Department for Business and Trade (DBT)
- Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs (Defra)
- Transparency data
- Open Government Licence v3.0
- HM Courts & Tribunals Service

## Tax and Employment Guidance

- [Tell HMRC if you have a new job or more than one job](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tell-hmrc-if-you-have-a-new-job-or-more-than-one-job): Guide to updating HMRC about new employment & correcting PAYE tax codes
- [EIM23810 - Car benefit: special cases: demonstration and courtesy cars](https://www.gov.uk/hmrc-internal-manuals/employment-income-manual/eim23810): HMRC guidance on car benefit charges for demonstration & courtesy cars

## Policy Reviews and Government Responses

- [The Rock Review: summary and recommendations](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-rock-review-working-together-for-a-thriving-agricultural-tenanted-sector/the-rock-review-summary-and-recommendations): Rock Review summary on agricultural tenancies & landlord-tenant relations
- [Building safety: remediation and funding - government response](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/building-safety-remediation-and-funding-government-response-to-the-select-committee-reports/building-safety-remediation-and-funding-government-response-to-the-select-committee-reports): Govt response on building safety & cladding remediation post-Grenfell

## Official Statistics

- [Migration in the UK: Aug 2014](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/migration-statistics-quarterly-report-august-2014): UK migration statistics quarterly report Aug 2014 from ONS
- [Statutory homelessness, England: October to December 2016](https://www.gov.uk/government/statistics/announcements/statutory-homelessness-england-october-to-december-2016-and-homelessness-prevention-and-relief-england-october-to-december-2016): England homelessness statistics Q4 2016: statutory & prevention data
- [DBT: workforce management information November 2023](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/dbt-workforce-management-information-november-2023): DBT workforce data: staff numbers, headcount & payroll Nov 2023

## Employment Tribunal Decisions

- [Mr J Wallwork v WRG Creative Communications Ltd: 2400263/2020](https://www.gov.uk/employment-tribunal-decisions/mr-j-wallwork-v-wrg-creative-communications-ltd-2400263-2020): Employment Tribunal decision: Wallwork v WRG Creative Communications
- [Mr A Lennox v Marston's Trading Ltd: 2408140/2021](https://www.gov.uk/employment-tribunal-decisions/mr-a-lennox-v-marstons-trading-ltd-2408140-slash-2021): Employment Tribunal decision: Lennox v Marston's Trading Ltd
- [K Apcewicz v DMF Engineering Fabrication Ltd: 8000434/2024](https://www.gov.uk/employment-tribunal-decisions/k-apcewicz-v-dmf-engineering-fabrication-ltd-8000434-slash-2024): Scotland Employment Tribunal: Apcewicz v DMF Engineering wages case

## Optional

- [Signed order on Amazon Sells Limited](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/company-names-tribunal-decision-amazon-sells-limited/signed-order-on-amazon-sells-limited): Company Names Tribunal order: Amazon Sells Ltd name change decision
- [NG2 3AB, Enviroenergy Limited: environmental permit issued](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ng2-3ab-enviroenergy-limited-environmental-permit-issued): Environmental permit for Enviroenergy London Road Heat Station Nottingham
- [G8認知症サミットが開催されました](https://www.gov.uk/government/world-location-news/212474.ja): G8 dementia summit announcement from British Embassy Tokyo
